data.name: Setup_Subtitle
data.value: Choose how LabelScope appears to Windows and how it draws labels.

data.name: Setup_ReinstallTip
data.value: Saves these settings, then removes the LabelScope printer from Windows and adds it again with this name. Windows asks for permission.

data.name: Setup_StatusInstalled
data.value: Installed — choose “{0}” in any Windows print dialog.

data.name: Setup_StatusNotInstalled
data.value: Not installed — click Reinstall printer to add “{0}” to Windows.

data.name: Setup_StatusNameTaken
data.value: Another Windows printer already uses the name “{0}”. LabelScope never changes it; type a different name.

data.name: Setup_StatusUnknown
data.value: LabelScope could not check the printer. Click Reinstall printer to try again; details are in the log folder.

data.name: Setup_StatusWorking
data.value: Reinstalling “{0}”… Windows will ask for permission.

data.name: Setup_ShowNewest
data.value: _Show the newest job as it arrives

data.name: Setup_OpenSettingsFileTip
data.value: Closes this window and opens settings.json, for settings that are not on this screen.

data.name: Setup_NameEmpty
data.value: Type a name for the printer, for example LabelScope, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_NameTooLong
data.value: The printer name is too long ({0} characters at most). Shorten it, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_NameControlChars
data.value: The printer name must be one line of normal text. Remove line breaks and hidden characters, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_NameForbiddenChars
data.value: The printer name must not contain \ / ! * ? [ or ]. Remove them, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_NameTaken
data.value: Another Windows printer already uses the name “{0}”, and LabelScope never changes it. Type a different name, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_WidthInvalid
data.value: The label width must be a number from 5 to 2000 mm. Type the width in millimetres, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_HeightInvalid
data.value: The label height must be a number from 5 to 2000 mm. Type the height in millimetres, then click Save again.

data.name: Setup_ActionFailed
data.value: The printer action did not finish. Details are in the log folder; try again.

data.name: Setup_OldPrinterKept
data.value: The printer “{0}” is installed, but the old printer “{1}” is still in Windows: {2} You can remove it yourself in Windows Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners.

data.name: Setup_OpenFailed
data.value: Printer setup could not be shown. Details are in the log folder; try again.

data.name: Setup_ApplyFailed
data.value: The new settings were saved, but not all of them could be applied. Close LabelScope and start it again.
